name: document-writer
description: Persists a finished document to the store. Assembles the record from the cleaned content and classification produced upstream and writes it (create on ingest, update on a correction).

skills.name: Persist document
skills.description: Writes a document record (title, content, summary, tags) to the store via create_document, or applies an edit via update_document, returning the document id.
examples: Save this cleaned document with its tags and summary
Update the stored document's title to the corrected one
